title: Localize the hardcoded English preset/fallback strings in the track-setup wizard (step_chazara, step_scope, step_starting_position*)

evidence.quote: 'No local calendar entry found for this date.',

why: This app ships full EN/HE parity (1421 ARB keys) everywhere else, but these six literals never go through AppLocalizations. The two step_chazara.dart sites are the worst: ChazaraInlineSetup's four preset cards ('Learn Only' / '1 day' / '1 + 7 days' / '1 + 7 + 30 days' as titles, plus 'No scheduled reviews.' / 'The recommended starter.' etc. as subtitles, confirmed rendered via ReviewPresetCard's Text(title)/Text(subtitle)) are shown on EVERY self-paced-track chazara-setup screen — a Hebrew-locale user seeing an otherwise-Hebrew wizard hits four cards of plain English text on a step every family using the app passes through. The other four are lower-traffic fallback/error strings (a tooltip, two level-label fallbacks, and a 'no calendar entry' error message) but are equally un-translatable.
recommendation: Add ARB keys (with EN+HE translations) for the four preset titles + four preset descriptions, the 'Back to {level} list' tooltip, the generic 'Item' level fallback, the 'Level {n}' fallback, and the 'no calendar entry' message; thread AppLocalizations through _presetDescription/_ChazaraPreset and the two fallback sites the same way the rest of each file already does.
acceptance_criteria: root `make arb-parity` still reports 100% EN/HE key coverage after the new keys are added.
A grep for single-quoted literal Latin-alphabet strings passed to `title:`/`subtitle:`/`tooltip:`/`Text(` in these four files returns nothing.
A Locale('he') widget test on ChazaraInlineSetup asserts none of the four preset card texts render in Latin script.
